name: Queueing under overload: adaptive LIFO + CoDel
description: Two API servers, 16 slots each, about 20 ms per request: at most about 1,600 requests per second. From second 20 traffic becomes 2,000/s, above capacity. A normal first-in-first-out (FIFO) queue keeps growing, and by the time a request is served its client has timed out: 80% of requests fail. This design uses Facebook's approach: when congested, serve the newest request first (adaptive LIFO), and drop a request that waited too long when its turn comes (CoDel). The servers are still fully busy, but they work on requests someone is waiting for: only 24% fail, about the part above capacity, and they fail at once instead of after a 1 s timeout. Set "Queue order" back to FIFO and "CoDel queue target" to 0 to compare.
